name: bad-deploy
description: Payments v2.4.1 shrinks the DB connection pool from 50 to 5; payments times out and checkout fails on its payment calls.

changes.detail: deploy payments v2.4.0 -> v2.4.1 (release notes: refactor DB client configuration)

log_effects.message: db pool at capacity: active=5 max=5 waiting={n}
connection pool exhausted: timed out waiting for a connection after {ms}ms
payment authorisation failed for order {id}: upstream payments returned 503

ground_truth.root_cause: The payments v2.4.1 deploy at 14:02 shrank the payments DB connection pool (max 5), exhausting it; checkout's payment calls failed.
